description.zh: 流水线最后执行结束时间
description.en: Last execution end time of the pipeline

description.zh: 流水线最后执行开始时间
description.en: Last execution start time of the pipeline
Number of items per page. Maximum supported value is 50.

description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

description.zh: 流水线最后运行状态，多个逗号分割，SUCCESS 运行成功,   RUNNING 运行中,FAIL 运行失败,CANCELED 已取消,WAITING等待中
description.en: Last run status of the pipeline. Multiple values separated by commas. Valid values: SUCCESS (Succeeded), RUNNING (running), FAIL (failed), CANCELED (canceled), WAITING (waiting)

title.zh: 获取流水线分组下流水线列表
title.en: Obtain the list of pipelines under a pipeline group
